name: ERA5 meteorological reanalysis
resolution: N320 reduced Gaussian and T639 spectral remapped to ~80 km ICON grid with 27 vertical levels
access: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) Climate Data Store (CDS), doi: 10.24381/cds.bd0915c6

scales.note: ERA5/ERA5.1 reanalysis from 1979 to 2021 sampled the first day of each quarter at 3-hourly intervals, remapped to ~80 km.
